decisions.reason: Reviewing JLCPCB passive-component costs does not change whether the KiCad project resolves without local footprint dependencies.
The source does not change the required I2C resistor values, placement, or signal-conditioning policy; package sourcing can be reviewed independently.
The source requests review of costly passive selections and does not change any interboard connector type, pinout, or power topology.
The passive-component sourcing review does not alter panel input assignments, mounting, or active-low behavior.
The source does not change the battery connector's placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source does not change the sensor-board connector inventory, connector count, or module pinouts.
JLCPCB passive-component setup fees do not affect the established ESP32-S3 GPIO assignments or compatibility rules.
The source specifically questions resistor and capacitor Extended classifications and does not change the LED supply voltage, level-shifter requirement, or selected level-shifter part.
The client explicitly treats an Extended classification for the AXP as expected, and the source does not change the AXP2101 power-path topology.
A possible sourcing or package change for capacitors does not alter the required 1uF capacitances or BOOT/reset circuit behavior.
